description: A front-end HTML file for a web-based database viewer interface, including embedded CSS styles and JavaScript for dynamic behavior, such as loading database lists, tables, and data, with refresh and expand functionalities.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list and resets UI states.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database's tables list.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and renders data from the selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Constructs HTML for table data with features like wide content expansion.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates table cell content, handling nulls, objects, and long strings.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Toggles expanded view for table cell content.
